metadata.title: Product Bricks & Streams
metadata.description: Hierarchical product brick map for the occupational-health-and-safety-platform domain, modeled on Kitry: workforce and exposure data synchronised from HR systems, the Occupational Health module (scheduling, consultation, questionnaires, connected devices, teleconsultation, campaigns and the occupational medical file), the Workplace Safety module (risk assessment, hazardous situations, inspections, action plans, chemicals), the Work Accidents and Occupational Diseases module with national reporting connectors, employee and manager portals, dashboards and regulatory reports, and the platform foundation of identity, configuration, FR/BE/LU/NL regulation content, audit, HDS/ISO 27001 hosting, ecosystem integrations and service delivery.

rootGroups.name: Workforce and Exposure Data
rootGroups.description: The connected record of workers, contracts, assignments, sites and workstations synchronised from HR systems, with the exposure and risk profiles per workstation and the surveillance rules that derive required examinations and periodicity per country — the spine that drives medical surveillance, safety and reporting.

bricks.name: Worker, Contract and Assignment Registry
bricks.description: The register of every worker the occupational health service is responsible for: identity, contracts, employer entity, assignments to organisation units and workstations with validity dates, employment status (active, absent, left, temporary, apprentice, external) and the surveillance category derived from the assignment. It is the spine that connects the HRIS, the medical file, the risk assessment and the accident register, and the reason Kitry can track more than 4 million employee records across 150+ organisations; every other brick keys on the worker and assignment identifiers it publishes.

subGroups.name: Exposure and Surveillance Rules
subGroups.description: Exposure profiles per workstation and worker, and the rule engine that turns them into surveillance schedules.

bricks.name: Exposure and Risk Profile Register
bricks.description: The register of exposures and risk factors per workstation and per worker: night work, chemical agents (including CMR), biological agents, physical agents (noise, vibration, radiation), ergonomic and psychosocial factors, safety-critical posts and other special-surveillance categories (suivi individuel renforcé in France, health surveillance categories in Belgium). Profiles are inherited from the workstation and can be individualised per worker, and they are the input both to surveillance rules and to the risk assessment, the strategic link between the medical and the safety modules.

bricks.name: Surveillance Rules and Periodicity Engine
bricks.description: The rule engine that derives, for every worker, which examinations are required (initial visit, periodic visit, enhanced individual surveillance, return-to-work visit, mid-career visit, nurse visit, pre-departure visit, Belgian periodic health assessment) and when they fall due, from the country's regulation, the worker's exposure profile, age and contract events. It maintains the surveillance schedule that scheduling works from and that the coverage KPIs are computed on, and it recalculates automatically whenever HR, exposure or examination events arrive.
